newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's June mined gold output rises 4.0 percent.
newsitem.headline: Peru's June mined gold output rises 4.0 percent.

text.p: Peru's gold output rose 4.0 percent to 5.869 tonnes in June compared with the same month last year, according to preliminary figures released Thursday by Energy and Mines Ministry.
Gold output rose 7.5 percent to 34.317 tonnes in the first half of the year, compared to the same period last year, the ministry added in its monthly report.
Peru's gold production in 1996 rose 12.2 percent to 64.8 tonnes from 57.7 tonnes.

Peru is Latin America's second largest gold producer after Brazil and the 12th largest in the world. The country's largest gold producer is Minera Yanacocha S.A., a joint venture operated by Newmont Mining Co.
The ministry's figures include estimates for output by Peru's informal gold miners, who account for about 40 percent of national output.
